Sample.evidence_source: [/page/11/Text/6] "23 of the 36 pro-social subjects experienced a drop in β strong enough for them to change their decision. The remaining 13 experienced either no drop in β or it was too small to affect their choice." and "at least 23 of the 54 pro-selfs are either not sensitive to cognitive dissonance or self-deception, or experienced no drop at all in β. For the 31 who chose to ignore, cognitive dissonance weakly decreased since φ either increased (drop in β) or remained constant (constant β)."
